paragraphs: Versaterm sells software to public safety agencies, built around a CAD system so that dispatch and the field work from the same real-time information. Records are the other core piece, and Versaterm says a modern RMS cuts manual effort and keeps information available from patrol through command.

Named products for community communication include Versaterm CommunityConnect, Versaterm CommunityReport, Versaterm CallTriage, and Versaterm Public Portal. Versaterm IAPro and Versaterm BlueTeam cover professional standards work, alongside professional standards training. Two further named products are Versaterm Mindbase and Versaterm EIPro.

DroneSense by Versaterm handles drone operations, and Glendale Police uses Versaterm DroneSense flight management software with the SafeSky traffic awareness app. The company says it has worked with agencies for over 47 years. The Sumner County Sheriff's Office won first place in the 2026 Versaterm Innovation Awards for its use of technology and data in its school resource officer division.

quote.text: Protecting communities requires clarity before action, accountability after and care throughout every response, supported by responsible innovation.
